planning.hub.title_text: Free Wedding Planning Tools by Timeline | No Signup
planning.hub.meta_description: 14 free wedding planning tools in the order you need them: checklist, guest count, drinks, cake, timeline, vows and thank-you notes. No signup.
planning.hub.h1: Free Wedding Planning Tools, in the Order You'll Need Them
planning.hub.lead: Most tool lists are grouped by feature. Planning a wedding is grouped by date. Here are 14 free browser tools arranged from the first big decisions to the last thank-you note — nothing to install, nothing to sign up for.
planning.hub.how_h2: How to use this planning toolkit
planning.hub.step1: Start with your date and guest count — the calculators scale everything else from those two numbers.
planning.hub.step2: Work one stage at a time. Each tool keeps its state in your browser, so you can close the tab and come back.
planning.hub.step3: Nothing is uploaded. Print or export each result before you move to the next stage.
planning.hub.timeline_h2: Every tool, in the order you'll need it
planning.hub.stage3: The last month — words and the day (4)
planning.hub.stage4: After the wedding — notes and admin (2)
planning.hub.q1: Are these planning tools really free?
planning.hub.a1: Yes. All 14 tools are free, run in your browser and need no account. Your entries stay on this device.
planning.hub.q2: Which tool should I start with?
planning.hub.a2: Start with the planning checklist and the guest count. Your date and headcount drive the drinks, cake, budget and seating decisions.
planning.hub.q3: Do these work for small or destination weddings?
planning.hub.a3: Yes. The calculators accept any guest count, and the timeline, checklist and wording tools work for elopements and destination weddings too.
